ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Reference to the Processor to lookup in the registry to use. A Processor is a class of type org.apache.camel.Processor, which can are to be called by this EIP. In this processor you have custom Java code, that can work with the message, such as to do custom business logic, special message manipulations and so on. By default, the ref, will lookup the bean in the Camel registry. The ref can use prefix that controls how the processor is obtained. You can use #bean:myBean where myBean is the id of the Camel processor (lookup). Can also be used for creating new beans by their class name by prefixing with #class, eg #class:com.foo.MyClassType. And it is also possible to refer to singleton beans by their type in the registry by prefixing with #type: syntax, eg #type:com.foo.MyClassType
